about: Curated inputs for the eval.py demo (iteration 4, evaluation 3). 'results' are the summary JSONs eval.py reads (whole); 'tables' are row subsets (42 held-out concepts, 30 specifications, 28 ledger rows) of the full tables (7,728 / 1,920 / 1,290 rows).

rows.record_key: portability_table DL4 of z/se_z (= prereg P3 new_edge_rate pooled_psp)

gate_T0.json.readme_note: README table shows M0_density_end +0.375 (O2r_m50, 0.3745) while portability/heldout_summary headline +0.377 is O2r_resid; both are reproduced here

verdict_rule.MOST: upper CI of pooled psp_post < 0.5 * pooled psp_full
verdict_rule.LITTLE: paired difference (full - post) pooled CI includes 0

collinearity_post_vs_B5_reach.note: D_vol_post counts off-home fields entered from t0..t0+2 papers only; B5 'reach' is built from the same window, so the two are near rank-identical and psp(D_vol_post | B5) rests on the few discordant ranks

heterogeneity.json.status: EXPLORATORY (old held-out, already unsealed); ecological traits (sub-unit medians)

meta_regression.method: REML + Knapp-Hartung; permutation p over trait shuffles; Holm over 7

definitions.D_rca_persist_k (Research 2, research_re: entered or RCA > 1 in each of t-k..t (predictor-side twin of Pinheiro 2022's Delta rule)
definitions.operationalisation_here: k yearly checks over years t-k..t-1 before risk year t (information set of the Exp7 predictors); 'entered' = state > 0 in Exp7's state panel; RCA-only variant also reported

drca_persist_comparison.json.verdict_reason: D_rca_pers requires RCA>1 in two window-aggregated 3-year blocks (t-3..t-1 and t-6..t-4), i.e. a 6-year horizon that tolerates single bad years; D_rca_persist_k requires the state in EACH single year t-k..t-1 and admits 'entered' presences below RCA 1. Neither set contains the other, so the constructs are not equivalent; the maximum rank correlation on DEV candidate rows is 0.877.

boundary_spec.json.title: Openness boundary evaluation - frozen specification (Part B, EXPLORATORY on already-unsealed held-out)
boundary_spec.json.status: EXPLORATORY: the Exp8 held-out groups were unsealed in Exp5 and Exp8; nothing here can confirm OPEN
boundary_spec.json.estimator: Exp8 psp: rank x,y within unit; OLS-residualise on [1, rank(B5 + extra controls), t0 dummies (+ group dummies in COH units)]; Pearson of residuals (vendor/rq1stats.psp_point)

pooling.primary_record_comparable: DL on Fisher z over the 4 held-out groups PHYS/LIFEENV/SOC/MATHDEC (Exp8 heldout.pool_block; the record's +0.377 etc. are DL4)
pooling.note: The plan text says the record pools over 6 units; Exp8 heldout.py pools over HELD_GROUPS (4). Both are reported; T0 uses DL4 with bootstrap se_z exactly as Exp8.

open_definition.z: z_c = sign_c * (x - mu_DEV) / sd_DEV (frozen constants below, applied to all rows)
open_definition.OPEN: mean of available component z; defined when >= 4 of 6 present
open_definition.OPEN_PC1: sum of loadings * z over the 6 components (complete cases), DEV PC1, sign so the new_edge_rate loading is positive
open_definition.subset_rule: subset of size s is defined when >= ceil(2s/3) of its components present

spec_grid.subsets: all 63 non-empty subsets of the 6 components
weightings: pc1 (refit on DEV for each subset of size >= 2)

controls.C0: B5 (no t0 dummies; group dummies kept in COH units)

spec_grid.se: analytic Fisher z, var = 1/(n - k - 3), k = columns of Z incl. intercept

null.detail: per unit x outcome x control: y* = fitted(y ~ Z_C) + within-unit permutation of residuals; all 1,920 specs recomputed per draw

spec_grid.calibration: headline + 50 random specs: 1,000-draw concept bootstrap; if the median bootstrap/analytic CI-width ratio > 1.2 the analytic SEs are inflated by it

B1.post: states() on gw (years t0..t0+2 only, zero before t0) -> D_vol_post, M0_density_post

footprint.D_vol_pre: # off-home fields entered (full-history state machine) by t0-1

verdict_rule.MOST: upper CI of pooled psp_post < 0.5 * pooled psp_full
verdict_rule.LITTLE: paired difference (full - post) pooled CI includes 0

B4.subunits: primary home field (first listed, 26-field level) x onset period (2003-09 / 2010-14) over the 6 held-out units; cells with n (O2r_m50 non-missing and OPEN defined) < 60 merge into '<unit>_other' (if still < 60 it is dropped); fallback threshold 40 if < 20 sub-units

generic_rule.head: last token of the lower-cased label after stripping parentheses

B4.meta_regression: REML random effects, one trait at a time, Knapp-Hartung; permutation p (1,000 trait shuffles); Holm over the 7 traits; joint model with the 2 strongest

lifeenv_verdict_rule.COVERAGE: coverage slope CI > 0 AND reweighted LIFEENV psp CI overlaps others' pooled CI
lifeenv_verdict_rule.VARIANCE: SD-ratio CI < 1 AND Thorndike-corrected LIFEENV psp inside others' pooled CI

boundary_spec.json.llm: no LLM calls (optional GENERIC LLM check not run; $0 spent)
